dialogue.origin: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: では、始めてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Well then, shall we begin?

dialogue.origin: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: 最初に、年齢・性別・今日お話ししたいことを教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、まき、34才、女性です。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm Maki, 34 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: 妊活しているのですが、上手くいかなくて
dialogue.content: I've been trying to conceive, but it's not going well.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。そうなんですね...もう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. I see... Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 不妊治療に通っているのですが、なかなか出来ないのと治療が結構辛くて
dialogue.content: I'm undergoing fertility treatment, but we haven't been successful, and the treatment is quite difficult.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはつらいですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 2年前には流産もあったので
dialogue.content: I also had a miscarriage two years ago.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今年35才だし、だんだん体力も心配で
dialogue.content: I'm turning 35 this year, and I'm starting to worry about my physical stamina.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。不安な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. It's natural to feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: このまま治療を続けても。。。と思うのと、子供をあきらめたくない思いがして
dialogue.content: I find myself thinking, 'What if I continue the treatment and it still doesn't work...?' but at the same time, I don't want to give up on having a child.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: この頃は眠ってもすぐ目が覚めて
dialogue.content: Lately, even when I sleep, I wake up right away.

dialogue.origin: 体温図らなきゃとか
dialogue.content: Thinking things like, 'I have to take my temperature.'

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 気づくとまだ2時台だったりして、ヤダ、もっと寝なきゃとか
dialogue.content: Before I know it, it's only two-something in the morning, and I think, 'Oh no, I need to sleep more.'

dialogue.origin: すごく迷います
dialogue.content: I'm very conflicted.

dialogue.origin: なるほど...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それは体力的にも
dialogue.content: That must be draining, both physically...

dialogue.origin: 精神的にも疲れますね
dialogue.content: ...and mentally.

dialogue.origin: はい7
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今妊活を始められてから
dialogue.content: Since you started trying to conceive...

dialogue.origin: どれくらいの期間ですか？
dialogue.content: ...how long has it been?

dialogue.origin: 6年目です
dialogue.content: It's been six years.

dialogue.origin: ６年目なんですね。
dialogue.content: Six years, I see.

dialogue.origin: 不安になるのも無理はないですよね
dialogue.content: It's completely understandable that you feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: つらい思いを誰かに聞いてもらうことは
dialogue.content: Do you have someone to talk to about these difficult feelings...

dialogue.origin: ありますか？
夫には話せていますが、夫は子供を欲しがっているのであまりきついことが言えないと言うか
dialogue.content: I can talk to my husband, but he really wants a child, so I feel like I can't say anything too harsh.

dialogue.origin: 私もあきらめたわけではないので
dialogue.content: And it's not like I've given up either.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: ついついソフトなおなか痛かったとか
dialogue.content: I end up just saying softer things like, 'My stomach hurt a bit,' or...

dialogue.origin: 身体がだるくて
dialogue.content: 'I feel sluggish,'

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 思うように動けないとか
dialogue.content: ...or 'I can't move around like I want to.'

dialogue.origin: そんな話になってしまいます
dialogue.content: The conversation ends up being like that.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのことも考えると
dialogue.content: So, when you think about your husband's feelings,

dialogue.origin: 正直なことを
dialogue.content: ...you find it difficult to be...

dialogue.origin: 言えなかったりもするんですね。
dialogue.content: ...completely honest.

dialogue.origin: 実際、体の感覚って男の人にはわからないし
dialogue.content: And really, men can't understand these physical sensations.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 40才過ぎてできた
dialogue.content: I hear stories of people who conceived after 40,

dialogue.origin: とかも聞くんですけど
dialogue.content: ...and things like that, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: そこまであと6年もこの辛い治療を続けるの？って思うと気持ちが折れて
dialogue.content: But when I think, 'Do I have to continue this painful treatment for another six years until then?' my spirit just breaks.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 夫の妹には孫がいるので
dialogue.content: My husband's sister has a child,

dialogue.origin: 義母には「きっとできるわよ」って
dialogue.content: so my mother-in-law tells me, 'I'm sure it will happen for you.'

dialogue.origin: 励まされてしまって
dialogue.content: She tries to encourage me, but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 悪気が無いのはわかるんですけど
dialogue.content: I know she means well, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 必ずできるって保証はないし
dialogue.content: there's no guarantee that it will definitely happen,

dialogue.origin: 絶対できないって、私が決めたら進まないし
dialogue.content: and if I decide it absolutely won't happen, we cannot move forward either.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 誰も悪くないけど、辛いのは私だけだから
dialogue.content: No one is at fault, but I'm the only one who's suffering.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいか分からなくなります
dialogue.content: I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 悪気はなくても
dialogue.content: Even if there's no ill intent,

dialogue.origin: まきさんには
dialogue.content: for you, Maki,

dialogue.origin: つらい気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.content: it still feels painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そう感じるのは、自然なことだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: まきさんは、
dialogue.content: Maki,

dialogue.origin: 今、状況を聴かせて頂きましたが、
dialogue.content: you've shared your situation with me just now,

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのような思いで
dialogue.content: but I was wondering with what thoughts or hopes...

dialogue.origin: ご相談に来られましたか？
dialogue.content: ...you came for counseling today?

dialogue.origin: 迷っている事の出口が見えるかもと
dialogue.content: I thought maybe I could find an exit from this state of indecision.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: 先ほどお話し頂いたことと
dialogue.content: This might overlap with what you've already said,

dialogue.origin: 重なるかもしれませんが、
dialogue.content: but...

dialogue.origin: まきさんが迷っていると感じるのは
dialogue.content: ...what specific aspects make you feel...

dialogue.origin: どのようなところでしょうか？
dialogue.content: ...so conflicted?

dialogue.origin: いたくて辛い治療ですが、痛いからと言ってやめてしまったらそれは子供を諦めることになるってわかっているけど、痛い日やだるい日にはこんな治療したって意味がないと言う気持ちになって辞めたくなります。
dialogue.content: The treatment is painful and difficult, and I know that stopping it just because it hurts would mean giving up on having a child. But on painful or sluggish days, I start to feel like there's no point in this treatment and I want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 夫の気持ちを考えたらやめたらいけない、もう少し頑張ろうと思います
dialogue.content: When I think about my husband's feelings, I feel I can't quit, that I have to try a little harder.

dialogue.origin: お金もかかるし
dialogue.content: It also costs a lot of money.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 嫌な日にはなんでこんなことしてるんだろうって
dialogue.content: On bad days, I wonder why I'm even doing this.

dialogue.origin: うん...
dialogue.content: Mm...

dialogue.origin: 涙が止まらない時もあります
dialogue.content: Sometimes I can't stop crying.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: でも妊娠できるのは私だけだし
dialogue.content: But I'm the only one who can get pregnant,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: やめたらそれは二人の人生が変わることだし
dialogue.content: If I stop, that would change both of our lives.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: なるほど...いろいろ考えますよね。まきさんは夫さんの気持ちを考えて、
dialogue.content: I see... there's so much to consider. You mentioned that you think about your husband's feelings and...

dialogue.origin: 妊活を続けようと思っていらっしゃる
dialogue.content: ...feel you should continue trying to conceive.

dialogue.origin: とのことでしたが、
dialogue.content: Is that right?

dialogue.origin: 夫もですが、私も子供は欲しいです
dialogue.content: It's not just my husband; I want a child too.

dialogue.origin: まきさんもなんですね。
dialogue.content: So you do as well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まきさんの中では
dialogue.content: For you, Maki,

dialogue.origin: 今のつらい気持ちを
dialogue.content: these painful feelings you're having now...

dialogue.origin: でも日によってやめたい気持ちが大きくなって
dialogue.content: But some days, a desire to quit becomes overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: その気持ちにどこで区切りを皆さんつけているのか
dialogue.content: and I wonder where other people draw the line with those feelings.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: やめる決断をするのが怖いし
dialogue.content: I'm afraid of making the decision to stop,

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...
dialogue.content: That makes sense...

dialogue.origin: 私の一存で良いのか
dialogue.content: and I wonder if it's okay for me to decide on my own.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 辛いと言えば夫は反対しないですから
dialogue.content: Because if I say it's too hard, my husband won't object.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まきさんが
dialogue.content: It sounds like you, Maki,

dialogue.origin: １人で気持ちを抱え込んでおられるように
dialogue.content: are carrying these feelings all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: 感じておられるように感じますが、
dialogue.content: That's the impression I get, but...

dialogue.origin: どのような感じですか？
dialogue.content: how does that feel to you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、一応夫と話せてはいます
dialogue.content: Well, I am able to talk with my husband to some extent.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。まきさんの中では
dialogue.content: I see. For you, Maki,

dialogue.origin: 今のこの妊活に対する不安な気持ちを
dialogue.content: if you could just calm these anxious feelings about trying to conceive,

dialogue.origin: 少しでも落ち着かせることができたら
dialogue.content: even a little,

dialogue.origin: 楽になれる感じですか？
dialogue.content: do you feel you would be more at ease?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、続ける意欲が欲しいと言うか
dialogue.content: Yes, I guess you could say I want the motivation to continue.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じです
dialogue.content: something like that.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まきさんも夫さんも
dialogue.content: So both you and your husband,

dialogue.origin: 望んでおられることは
dialogue.content: what you both want

dialogue.origin: 諦めずに続けるたいお気持ちなのですね。
dialogue.content: is to continue without giving up.

dialogue.origin: 今、続けるか迷うのは、
dialogue.content: Right now, what makes you hesitate to continue is...

dialogue.origin: どのような気持ちが一番影響していますか？
dialogue.content: ...what feeling is affecting you the most?

dialogue.origin: いかがですか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I'm not sure.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どこで区切りを付けたら良いのかが
dialogue.content: I don't know where to draw the line.

dialogue.origin: くぎってはいけないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Or maybe I shouldn't draw one at all?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。まきさんは区切るとしたら
dialogue.content: Right. If you were to draw a line,

dialogue.origin: どのようにしたいと思っておられますか？
dialogue.content: how would you want to do it?

dialogue.origin: もう子供を諦めるってどう結審したらいいのか
dialogue.content: How should I reach a final decision to give up on having children—

dialogue.origin: 決心
dialogue.content: I mean, 'make up my mind.'

dialogue.origin: うんうん…
dialogue.content: Mm-hm...

dialogue.origin: なかなか決心できないことですよね
dialogue.content: That's not an easy decision to make.

dialogue.origin: 区切ることに関しては
dialogue.content: Regarding the idea of drawing a line,

dialogue.origin: 夫さんとはまだお話しできていない状況ですか？
dialogue.content: is that something you haven't been able to talk about with your husband yet?

dialogue.origin: お互いに迷ってしまって結論が出せないところです
dialogue.content: We're both so conflicted that we can't reach a conclusion.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。迷うのも無理はないですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's only natural that you'd both be conflicted.

dialogue.origin: もう少しやってみます
dialogue.content: I'll try a little longer.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。なかなかすぐすっきりしないことかもしれませんが、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. I know this isn't something that can be resolved quickly, but...

dialogue.origin: また相談したいと思ったときは
dialogue.content: if you ever feel you'd like to talk again,

dialogue.origin: いつでもこちらの窓口をご利用くださいね。
dialogue.content: please feel free to use our services anytime.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。寒い日が続きますので、ご自愛くださいね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. It's been cold lately, so please take care of yourself.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それでは、ここで相談を終了させて頂きます
dialogue.content: Well then, we will conclude the session here.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: しつれいします
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

topic.sub: 不妊治療に関するプレッシャー
